svg.title: Download and start guided setup in PowerShell
svg.desc: An illustrative PowerShell session downloads Setup-Epp.ps1 from the repository, pauses for script review, and runs the script.
svg.text: Azure Cloud Shell or PowerShell 7 - download, review, and run

g.text: # Download into your private working folder.
# Review the downloaded script before running it.
JavaScript is the default. Use -Language csharp or -Language python to choose another runtime.
